inlines.v: PRE-ENGA'GEMENT, noun Prior engagement; as by stipulation or promise. A would accept my invitation, but for his pre-engagement to B. 1. Any previous attachment binding the will or affections. My pre-engagements to other themes were not unknown to those for whom I was to write.
